name: Milena Petrović
bio: Milena's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the vibrant liveries adorning racing cars. This passion led her to pursue a degree in automotive design, specializing in paint technology and application. After graduating, she honed her skills at a local custom shop, quickly establishing a reputation for meticulous attention to detail and creative flair. Now at Brasil Racing, Milena thrives on the challenge of translating aerodynamic efficiency and team branding into visually stunning and durable paint finishes. Her innovative approach to color blending and protective coatings ensures that the team's cars not only look exceptional but also maintain a competitive edge on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied in a high ponytail.
physical.description: Milena is of average height with a lean build, often sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones while working, even when not listening to music.
Has a collection of miniature racing car models on her workbench.
Meticulously cleans her spray guns after every use, regardless of how busy she is.
